newsitem.title: USA: PECO Limerick 2 nuke cuts power amid startup.
newsitem.headline: PECO Limerick 2 nuke cuts power amid startup.

text.p: Output at PECO Energy Co's 1,055 megawatt (MW) Limerick 2 nuclear generating unit was reduced over the weekend to correct an exhaust gas problem, the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Monday.
The NRC did not elaborate on the problem and PECO officials were not immediately available for comment.
As of early Monday, the unit was running at about 15 percent of its rated capacity.
It was in the process of being brought back on line after being shut December 6 to stop an oil leak in the turbine's electric hydraulic control system.
PECO said Friday it expected the unit to resume power production on Saturday.
The nearby Limerick 1, also rated at 1,055 MW, was running at full capacity.
Both Limerick units are in Pottsdom, Pa.
